title: Chapter 271
text:
"Isn't this the way to open treasure chests?"

This idea spread like a virus, and the players' interest was piqued. Some of the gamblers were so excited that their hands were trembling, and they could not wait to go all out. The most low-traffic, commercial-free website on mobile phones.

Opening treasure chests was also known as the Evil Road of Paywalls. It was a classic way for game developers to generate revenue, and Han Xiao was naturally very familiar with it. Not only could it ignite the gamblers' desire to gamble, but he could also earn a huge sum of money if they fell into the trap.

Coincidentally, he had the conditions and needs to do so, so he could use it as one of his regular activities to attract players.

Every planet had its own currency, and after the three Universal Civilizations established Order, for the convenience of communication, they created a universal culture, a universal currency, and a universal language. The unique currencies of the various galactic civilizations could be converted into the universal currency, but a surface civilization like Blue Star naturally did not have such a privilege. The Aquamarine Dollar had almost no purchasing power, and it could not be used in the universe at all.

Therefore, if one wanted to go to the galaxy, they had to first convert the money into resources and machines. Different civilizations had different prices for resources, and it could barely be considered a hard currency in the universe. No matter how bad it was, it was still more valuable than the Aquamarine Dollar. In Version 2.0, the novice planets would connect with the galactic civilizations in different ways, and the local currency would be exchanged, so the players did not have to worry about this problem. However, Han Xiao wanted to leave the novice planet in Version 1.0, so he had to pay attention to the differences in currency, language, culture, and so on.

His wealth was all in the Aquamarine Dollar, and it was a pile of waste paper outside of Blue Star. Therefore, he used it all to buy materials and machines. Furthermore, he could also gain some experience by making machines, increasing his foundation.

Because of this, he had accumulated a lot of useless machines, and he used them as prizes to open treasure chests. The drop rate of the treasure chests was completely under his control. Most of the treasure chests were filled with useless parts and garbage, and only a few of them contained good stuff. The cost would not exceed the profit, so it was a sure win.

Of course, the players would also spend money to bet on the future even if they knew that they could be unlucky. Before seeing a pile of garbage, everyone would feel lucky.

Even players who did not have much money would grit their teeth and buy one to try their luck. Even if they were unlucky, they would convince themselves that they would be lucky next time. They would never get tired of it.

"Most players like this kind of lucky draw. They have the opportunity to earn a huge profit with a very small cost. It's the same principle as the lottery. But now, other than me, there's no lucky draw anywhere else. There are two kinds of lucky draws. One is the game's official store. The lucky draw in the store is not online yet. It's mainly a special virtual item, such as Dungeon Crystals, Gene Repair Fluid, Red and Blue Potions, Experience Potions, and Fashion Accessories.

"The other is the actions of the storyline organizations and characters. This is the proper way to obtain direct benefits. For example, some organizations and organizations have a contribution system to draw powerful equipment and items, or some mysterious merchants have gambling games, and some organizations deal with old goods for the players to make money … When the organizations and civilizations understand the players better and treat them as mercenaries, the lucky draw for storyline characters will gradually appear. Speaking of which, it should be a new way for the organizations to drive the 'inhuman mercenaries', using profit as the motivation.

"My image in the eyes of the players is probably 'Planet Protagonist', 'Mechanic Mentor and Merchant', 'Handsome', 'Important NPC with Legendary Characteristics', and so on. The acceptance of me doing the lucky draw is also higher among the players. Furthermore, it's the first lucky draw, so it should attract more attention."

Han Xiao pondered.

Three thousand per box was not cheap, but the players at this level had some spare cash, so buying one or two boxes would not hurt them. If they got a piece of purple equipment, they would be rich. There was not a single piece of purple equipment on the market, which meant that it was a seller's market. The rarer something was, the more expensive it would be.

Their burning gazes immediately focused on the large truck full of boxes. All kinds of thoughts flashed in the eyes of the players. Then, they saw Han Xiao standing at the side, and all their thoughts were extinguished.

It was better to spend money honestly and not seek death.

Of the ten boxes, nine were trash, and one was purple. It was unknown whether Jade Green Sky was lucky or the ratio was that high to begin with.

The players started to buy enthusiastically, and the boxes were opened one after another. Some were happy, while others were sad. Other than trash, there were other things, such as some useful materials, some green equipment, and some blue equipment. Overall, the drop rate was quite high, but there was not a second piece of purple equipment.

"Could it be that the purple equipment is only dropped after ten consecutive draws?" A player's face was red, and he could not control himself. "It's hard to say.

I feel that the drop rate is a bit weird, and it can't be explained by normal logic … First, we have to understand one thing. Is the opening of the boxes introduced by Black Phantom a part of the game's plot? Everyone knows that it is extremely realistic, and every character seems to have their own logic, almost like the real world. A character's actions definitely have their own reasons and motives. So, is this lucky draw a function of the game official, or is he really clearing the storage … "A guy pushed his glasses up, and a wise light flashed through his lenses." But if he is clearing the storage, why didn't he just throw away the remaining items but sell them to us instead? "

"Wow, this guy is quite knowledgeable." Everyone was attracted by this guy's words, and they surrounded him. They looked up and saw that this guy's ID was' King of Single Draw '.

The surrounding players' mouths twitched.

No wonder he spoke so clearly. His ID showed that he was a veteran of the martial arts world.

Someone asked, "That's interesting, how do we tell?"

The storage of the heavy boxes was getting smaller and smaller. King of Single Draw's eyes flashed, and he walked past the crowd and asked loudly, "How many boxes are there left?"

Han Xiao waved his hand and said, "A total of 786 boxes, and there are 530 left."

The players were stunned, and there was an uproar. They thought that the boxes were unlimited, but they did not expect that it was limited. This time, some of the spectating players could not sit still anymore, and they waved their cash to join in the rush to buy the boxes.

King of Single Draw changed his posture, one hand on his chest, one hand on his chin, and he looked like a detective in deep thought. He said with certainty, "That's right, since it's limited, it can't be a function of the game official. Black Phantom is really clearing the storage, but he chose to seal the boxes and sell them instead of just throwing them away. Hmm … and there are still precious purple equipment in the storage, so this can't be considered a waste disposal at all. So, the only reason is that this is not a waste disposal in the true sense! Black Phantom is actually secretly giving us benefits by doing this. That's right, us' Inhumans' helped him build the sanctuary, so this is a hidden reward to us! "

King of Single Draw's voice was not soft, and when the players in the square heard it, they immediately agreed.

What he said was reasonable, and it was convincing.

"If it's a function of the game official, then the game official will definitely announce the drop rate, but if it's a part of the game's plot, then it's up to the players to experience it for themselves and summarize the hidden drop rate …"

King of Single Draw's eyes flashed. "For the sake of balance, the game official will definitely not draw anything too awesome, but if it's Black Phantom's reward lottery, it's different. You might really be able to get something good, which means that these mechanical boxes might drop some earth-shattering godly equipment!"

His words made everyone's blood boil. They gasped for breath like oxen. They were incomparably excited, and the crowd was in high spirits.

Han Xiao, who was beside him, was dumbfounded. He was completely confused and confused.
